knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Residue can contaminate the next product and can interfere with testing, so it is checked and removed.
The source describes no detectable residue as the ideal, with defined limits as the minimum standard.
A total figure can mask the specific residue, so each agent is measured separately.
The simple checks section says a commercial site seldom runs a full validation, but it can use a straightforward residue check where its procedure calls for one.

practicalCriteria: Learner rinses a practice item until no foam or detergent remains and states how the rinse was judged (pass: rinse completed and judged).
Learner records the agent, rinse method and check result on the practice record (pass: all recorded).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Foam or residue remains and the rinse cannot be repeated.
The residue check method is not approved for the site.
Rinse water would enter a drain that is not approved for it.
A reagent is used without its SDS or protective equipment.
